content:
Overview

Valga is a city in Valga County with a population of 12,000. A unique twin town on the Estonian-Latvian border, seamlessly connected to Valka (Latvia), with a shared history, the Pedele River, and a strong cross-border community. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
